capabilities: Render Pintora code blocks as diagrams
Copy diagrams to the clipboard as PNG or SVG
Export diagrams to png, svg, webp, or markdown files
Replace Pintora code with links to exported diagram files
Customize diagram themes, edge types, and titles
extras: Roadmap states no new features will be added; only bug fixes and tracking Pintora version updates. Rendering defaults to SVG but can be forced to Canvas via code block language labels.
problem: Obsidian only renders Mermaid diagrams natively, so notes written in Pintora syntax have no built-in way to display diagrams.

relations.evidence: Obsidian-Pintora is an Obsidian plugin based on Pintora

summary: Renders diagrams from Pintora syntax in code blocks, with copy, export to image files, lightbox viewing, and custom themes.
